podcast.body: This album was crucial in saving Kansas from being dropped by Don Kirshner's record label in 1975. Although their previous albums had sold acceptably, the band lacked a hit single until "Carry On Wayward Son" from this album. "The band saved themselves when they recorded the album Left Overcher."
